title: Next.js App Router
description: Checks for where components run, what crosses the client boundary and how server actions authorize requests.

rules.instruction: For App Router code, keep browser interaction in the Client Components that need it. Pass those components only the serializable fields they use.
rules.verification: Build the app and inspect the changed route for server-only imports or fields crossing into the client bundle or payload.

rules.instruction: Check authorization inside every changed server action that modifies protected resources.
rules.verification: Exercise the action with a permitted role and a role without access, and confirm that the refused call leaves the data unchanged.

rules.instruction: Validate the input of every changed server action on the server before using it.
rules.verification: Call the action with an invalid payload and confirm that it is rejected and the data stays unchanged.

rules.instruction: Reach protected data from server actions through the project's server-side data access layer where it exists.
rules.verification: Review the changed server actions for direct database or service calls that bypass the data access layer.

rules.instruction: After a server mutation, apply the project's cache and revalidation strategy to affected pages and data.
rules.verification: Verify the new state after submission, navigation and reload with the page's configured cache behavior.
